items.title_en: Japan adopts the 2026 Priority Plan for a digital society
items.title_ja: デジタル社会の実現に向けた2026年重点計画を閣議決定
items.summary_en: AI use, government-wide institutional reform, secure digital foundations and improved public services are brought together in Japan's current policy framework.
items.summary_ja: AI活用、政府横断の制度改革、安全なデジタル基盤、公共サービス改善を一体で示す最新政策枠組みです。
items.image_alt: Illuminated data-centre infrastructure supporting a connected digital society

items.source: United Nations ODET / UNU Macau / ADB
items.title_en: UN-led report defines governance conditions for AI as a Digital Public Good
items.title_ja: AIをDigital Public Goodとして扱うための統治条件を国連主導報告が提示
items.summary_en: Public value, accountability, safeguards, local relevance and lifecycle governance are identified as essential conditions.
items.summary_ja: 公共価値、説明責任、安全措置、地域適合性、ライフサイクル全体の統治を必要条件として示しています。
items.image_alt: High-performance computing and fibre infrastructure used for accountable AI systems

items.summary_en: The report connects digital-government maturity with data governance, AI, interoperable public services and institutional capacity.
items.summary_ja: データガバナンス、AI、相互運用可能な公共サービス、制度的実行能力をデジタル政府の成熟度と結び付けています。
items.image_alt: Research-grade server racks and connected infrastructure for interoperable public services

items.title_en: UNDP launches Blockchain Advisory Group for public-good applications
items.title_ja: UNDPが公共利益に向けたBlockchain Advisory Groupを設立
items.summary_en: The initiative examines financial inclusion, digital identity, interoperability and institutional readiness for digital public infrastructure.
items.summary_ja: 金融包摂、デジタルID、相互運用性、制度的準備を起点に、Blockchainによる公共基盤強化を検討します。
items.image_alt: UNDP Blockchain Advisory Group inaugural meeting in Paris

items.source: Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry, Japan
items.title_en: EU and Japan deepen cooperation on data, AI and trusted digital infrastructure
items.title_ja: 日EUがデータ、AI、信頼できるデジタル基盤の協力を深化
items.summary_en: The fourth Digital Partnership Council advanced DFFT, trustworthy AI, cybersecurity, digital identity and cross-border interoperability.
items.summary_ja: DFFT、信頼できるAI、サイバーセキュリティ、デジタルID、国境を越えた相互運用性を扱いました。
items.image_alt: National flags representing international digital cooperation and trusted cross-border data flows

items.title_en: Bank of Japan addresses the central bank's role in an AI-and-blockchain financial ecosystem
items.title_ja: 日本銀行がAIとBlockchainによる新金融エコシステムにおける中央銀行の役割を提示
items.summary_en: The address examines implementation across financial services and implications for trusted financial-market infrastructure.
items.summary_ja: AIとBlockchainが金融サービスで実装段階へ進む中、信頼される金融市場基盤への影響を論じています。
items.image_alt: Digital payment terminal representing trusted financial and settlement infrastructure
